requirements.text: Minimum Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or technical field such as computer science, math, statistics, physics, or a related discipline
Minimum 2 years of experience developing production-quality software, machine learning systems, or AI-powered applications using Python and/or C++
Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and applied machine learning (NLP, time-series analysis, GenAI)
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamental, including modular system design, APIs, testing, version control, and maintainable production code
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Graduate degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, or another quantitative field.
Hands-on experience building RAG systems, AI agents, LLM applications, or multimodal AI systems.
Exposure to reinforcement learning, recommendation systems, optimization, or time-series modeling.
Energized by the pace and ambiguity of a dynamic environment and comfortable rapidly learning unfamiliar technical areas.
